result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card is styled inconsistently and has poor contrast, making it hard to see and tap confidently.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' uses a dark/near-black circular background with a dark outlined heart, so the icon is barely visible against it. The equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above uses a white circle with a dark heart, so the two identical controls look different.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same white (or semi-transparent light) circular background and dark heart icon to all favorite buttons, ensuring at least 3:1 contrast between the icon and its background.

issues.description: Restaurant thumbnails in the 'Fastest near you' carousel have inconsistent image treatments — the Green Bowl Poké tile has a light grey background while the neighbouring tiles use dark, vignetted photography, breaking visual rhythm in the row.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail backgrounds/overlays across carousel items so all cards share a consistent tone and the white time badges remain readable on every tile.
